<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

 <meta charset="UTF-8" />

 <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>

 <title>Ezupp ERP - Transforming Sales Operations</title>


 <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">


 <style>

  body {

   margin: 0;

   font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;

   background: #0b0f1a;

   color: #e5e7eb;

   line-height: 1.6;

  }


  .container {

   max-width: 900px;

   margin: auto;

   padding: 20px;

  }


  .hero {

   margin-bottom: 30px;

  }


  .hero img {

   width: 100%;

   border-radius: 16px;

  }


  h1 {

   font-size: 36px;

   margin-top: 20px;

   color: #ffffff;

  }


  h2 {

   margin-top: 40px;

   color: #14b8a6;

  }


  p {

   margin: 15px 0;

   color: #cbd5f5;

  }


  .highlight {

   background: rgba(20,184,166,0.1);

   border-left: 4px solid #14b8a6;

   padding: 15px;

   margin: 20px 0;

   border-radius: 8px;

  }


  .flow {

   display: flex;

   flex-wrap: wrap;

   gap: 10px;

   margin: 20px 0;

  }


  .step {

   background: #111827;

   padding: 10px 15px;

   border-radius: 999px;

   border: 1px solid #1e293b;

   font-size: 14px;

  }


  footer {

   margin-top: 60px;

   text-align: center;

   font-size: 14px;

   color: #6b7280;

  }

 </style>

</head>


<body>


 <div class="container">


  <!-- HERO IMAGE -->

  <div class="hero">

   <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551288049-bebda4e38f71" alt="ERP Dashboard">

  </div>


  <!-- TITLE -->

  <h1>Run Your Entire Sales Ecosystem Without SAP Dependency</h1>


  <p>

   Modern businesses need speed, flexibility, and control. Yet, many organizations are still heavily dependent on legacy ERP systems like SAP for their daily sales operations — leading to delays, inefficiencies, and complexity.

  </p>


  <!-- PROBLEM -->

  <h2>The Problem with Traditional ERP Dependency</h2>


  <p>

   Managing customers, products, pricing, and orders through external ERP systems creates operational friction.

  </p>


  <div class="highlight">

   High dependency on sync cycles • Redundant data • Slow processing • Limited flexibility

  </div>


  <p>

   Sales teams often struggle with delayed order processing and lack of real-time visibility, impacting both productivity and customer experience.

  </p>


  <!-- SOLUTION -->

  <h2>Introducing Ezupp ERP</h2>


  <p>

   Ezupp ERP is designed to centralize your entire sales lifecycle — eliminating dependency on external systems and bringing everything into one powerful platform.

  </p>


  <p>

   From customer management to order execution, everything happens inside Ezupp — faster, cleaner, and smarter.

  </p>


  <!-- WORKFLOW -->

  <h2>Complete Order Lifecycle in One Flow</h2>


  <div class="flow">

   <div class="step">Punch</div>

   <div class="step">Quotation</div>

   <div class="step">Approval</div>

   <div class="step">Finalized</div>

   <div class="step">Confirmed</div>

   <div class="step">In Progress</div>

   <div class="step">Dispatched</div>

  </div>


  <p>

   Every step is tracked in real-time, ensuring complete visibility and zero confusion across teams.

  </p>


  <!-- FEATURES -->

  <h2>More Than Just Sales Management</h2>


  <p>

   Ezupp also powers a full ecosystem including:

  </p>


  <ul>

   <li>📱 Sales & Partner Mobile Apps</li>

   <li>🧾 Admin Dashboard</li>

   <li>💬 WhatsApp Integration</li>

   <li>🎁 Loyalty & Rewards System</li>

   <li>🔐 Digital Warranty Activation</li>

  </ul>


  <!-- WARRANTY -->

  <h2>Smart Warranty & Sales Tracking</h2>


  <p>

   With QR-based activation, businesses can track product journeys from Primary → Secondary → Tertiary sales — ensuring transparency and preventing fraud.

  </p>


  <!-- BENEFITS -->

  <h2>Why Businesses Choose Ezupp</h2>


  <div class="highlight">

   Faster processing • Single source of truth • Better visibility • Flexible workflows

  </div>


  <p>

   By removing SAP dependency, Ezupp empowers organizations to operate with speed, clarity, and complete control.

  </p>


  <!-- CTA -->

  <h2>Ready to Transform Your Sales Operations?</h2>


  <p>

   Step into a faster, smarter, and more agile sales ecosystem with Ezupp ERP.

  </p>


  <footer>

   © 2026 Ezupp ERP • All rights reserved

  </footer>


 </div>


</body>

</html>
